verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships Loop, its own AI agent. The docs say it lets users investigate logs through natural language instead of writing queries, and that you can ask it to build scorers, datasets, and dashboards. Its official MCP server also lets users query logs, author scorers, and run evals from MCP clients. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how broadly Loop's natural-language commands cover the full product (e.g., admin/configuration actions), independent or hands-on corroboration of Loop's natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Loop is Braintrust’s AI agent. It understands your data structure, so you can investigate your logs through natural language instead of writing queries.
Ask Braintrust’s AI agent to investigate your data and build scorers, datasets, and dashboards
Build datasets from production logs, user feedback, manual curation, or generate them with Loop.
Query production logs, author prompts and scorers, configure monitoring, and run evals from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, and any other MCP-compatible client.
